independentNativeWalkAudit.verification: Native recorded sample points only; not a continuous swept-path audit
limits: Real-time door leaf angles are excluded here and checked by native benchmark expectedMax assertions.
Samples do not establish that the unrecorded path between them is collision-free.
Production continuous sweep and dedicated thin-obstacle automated tests verify segment collision.
This does not establish route planning, whole-home accessibility or code compliance.
Use zones are explicit editable planning rectangles, not manufacturer dimensions or code compliance.
2D exports follow canvas bounds and overlay visibility; out-of-canvas envelope portions can be cropped.
Independent walking geometry audit proves sampled points only; production sweep, thin-obstacle tests and native door benchmarks cover segments and visible doors.
No door-induced physical pushing, multi-floor, diagonal openings, generic arbitrary-model maximum-clearance guarantee, Safari/Edge, physical touchscreen or physical printer acceptance.
